schema_note: OPERATION XXV-2 (#166). Independent-measurement holdouts for the measured_validation lane of science/status_record.py. Each entry: {"id": str, "description": str, "prereg_commit": full or abbreviated git SHA of the commit that preregistered the comparison BEFORE it was run, "qualified": bool (true only for an independent measurement with a stated uncertainty, preregistered with a fail-capable criterion), "outcome": "PASS" | "FAIL" | "PENDING", "evidence": repo path of the committed result}. The lane is PASS only if some entry has qualified == true (a JSON boolean), outcome == "PASS", and a prereg_commit that is an ancestor of the run commit; a qualified FAIL makes it FAIL; anything else is UNVERIFIED. No entry exists today: OPERATION XXIV section 6 found no qualified independent holdout (2.0-alpha gate NOT MET).
